source.title: 2026 Annual Active ND Sanitary Pumper List
notes: Header on the PDF: Pumpers listed were licensed on or before 07/23/2026.
Class I / Class II are DEQ sanitary-pumper permit classes, not inspection credentials. A pump is not an inspection.
Five rows have a blank Business County on the PDF (Minnesota street addresses). County is marked unknown. Not inferred.
10-digit phone strings such as 7015007390 are formatted as 701-500-7390. No digits were added.
License plate numbers are in the JSON because they appear on the official list; they are omitted from the HTML table.
